candidate.answerReason: An inclination of 120° gives an upward-left direction, so following the line from left to right makes it fall.

methods.label: Interpret an obtuse inclination
methods.explanation: When the angle of inclination is greater than \(90^\circ\) and less than \(180^\circ\), the line falls from left to right.
methods.levelReason: The direction follows geometrically from the inclination interval; no tangent calculation is needed.
